description:
No. 5 Store Street, Tullamore, Co. Offaly. A Substantial Period Residence In The Heart Of Tullamore

DNG Kelly Duncan proudly presents to the market No. 5 Store Street, Tullamore, Co. Offaly, a beautifully positioned end-of-terrace period residence occupying a prominent setting in the very heart of Tullamore town.

Extending to approximately 220 m² and arranged over three floors, No. 5 is an impressive and highly versatile home offering generously proportioned accommodation in an exceptionally convenient town-centre location. Presented in pristine, walk-in condition throughout, the property combines the character and presence of a period residence with a flexible layout ideally suited to modern family living.

No. 5 is a Protected Structure, recorded in the County Offaly Record of Protected Structures, reflecting the architectural character and heritage of this distinctive period property. Traditional timber-framed sash windows further complement its period character.

The ground-floor accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, living room opening through to a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen/dining room, utility room, bathroom and separate sitting room, currently in use as a ground-floor bedroom. The positioning of the bathroom alongside this room provides considerable flexibility, allowing this area to function particularly well as guest accommodation, a ground-floor bedroom suite or an additional reception room, depending on individual requirements.

The upper floors continue this sense of space and versatility. On the first floor, Bedroom Suite 1 incorporates a private living area and bathroom together with an adjoining dual-aspect bedroom. On the opposite side of the landing is Bedroom 3, another dual-aspect bedroom complete with its own en-suite.

The second floor offers a similar arrangement, with Bedroom Suite 2 comprising a separate living area, bathroom and adjoining dual-aspect bedroom. Completing the accommodation is Bedroom 4, a generously proportioned dual-aspect bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a recently modernised en-suite. Vaulted ceilings throughout much of the second-floor accommodation add further character and enhance the sense of space.

A particularly valuable feature of No. 5 is the adjoining garage extending to approximately 18 m², with direct vehicular access from Store Street. The garage provides private off-street parking — a significant advantage in such a central location — together with direct access through to the rear of the property.

To the rear is a private, enclosed and low-maintenance courtyard garden incorporating a patio area. Directly accessible from the kitchen/dining room through glazed sliding doors, and also through the adjoining garage, it provides an attractive and easily maintained outdoor space.

Further features include electric heating throughout and timber-framed sash windows to the front and rear. The property is BER exempt and is presented ready for immediate occupation.

Few residential properties can offer a more central position within Tullamore. Store Street places No. 5 at the heart of this thriving county town, with an extensive selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, leisure facilities, professional services and everyday amenities all within easy walking distance.

Tullamore Train Station and Midland Regional Hospital Tullamore are both just a short stroll away, further underlining the exceptional convenience of this town-centre setting. The combination of such a central location with substantial accommodation, private outdoor space and off-street parking is particularly difficult to replicate.

With its architectural character, impressive proportions, four principal bedrooms, two distinctive suite-style arrangements, versatile ground-floor accommodation, private courtyard and adjoining garage, No. 5 Store Street represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial period family home in the very heart of Tullamore.

Viewing Is Strictly By Appointment With Sole Selling Agents DNG Kelly Duncan, Who Can Be Contacted On 057 93 25050.

DNG Kelly Duncan – Your Trusted Real Estate Partner.

Kitchen/Dining Room 6.13m x 3.60m. A particularly light-filled, west-facing space with porcelain tiled flooring and extensive glazing across the rear wall, complemented by two Velux windows. Glass-panelled sliding doors provide direct access to the rear patio/courtyard.
Floor and eye-level cream fitted kitchen with contrasting walnut worktops, tiled splashback, sink, electric oven, electric hob and extractor fan. Space for fridge/freezer and electric storage heater.

Bathroom 1.75m x 2.27m. Fully tiled bathroom comprising electric power shower, wash hand basin with fitted mirror and shaver light, toilet, extractor fan and downlighters.

Bedroom Suite 2 4.42m x 5.04m. Living area with laminate timber flooring, vaulted ceiling, downlighters, ample sockets, TV point and phone point. Provides access to the adjoining bathroom and bedroom.

Bedroom 2 3.06m x 5.41m. Dual-aspect bedroom with laminate timber flooring and vaulted ceiling, complemented by downlighters, electric storage heater, ample sockets and TV point.

Bathroom 1.81m x 1.98m. Fully tiled bathroom comprising mains-powered shower, wash hand basin with fitted mirror and shaver light, toilet, extractor fan and downlighters.

Bedroom 3 3.55m x 4.94m. First floor dual-aspect bedroom positioned on the opposite side of the landing, with laminate timber flooring, electric storage heater, downlighters, ample sockets, TV point and phone point. Complete with its own en-suite bathroom.

Ensuite Bathroom 0.99m x 2.67m. Fully tiled and comprising mains-powered shower, wash hand basin with fitted mirror and shaver light, toilet, extractor fan and downlighters.

Bedroom 4 6.29m x 5.00m. Second floor dual-aspect bedroom featuring laminate timber flooring, vaulted ceiling, downlighters and electric storage heating. Built-in wardrobes provide ample storage, while the room also benefits from ample sockets, TV point and phone point. Complete with its own recently modernised en-suite.
